# Raw response to GET /_/TRACK (all tracks, including master at index 0)
# Format: TRACK \t idx \t name \t flags \t vol \t pan \t last_meter_peak \t last_meter_pos \t width/pan2 \t panmode \t sendcnt \t recvcnt \t hwoutcnt \t color
#
# flags bitmask (from REAPER's own main.js doc comment, confirmed empirically):
#   1   folder
#   2   selected
#   4   has FX
#   8   muted
#   16  soloed
#   32  solo-in-place (set alongside 16 when SOLO/1 is used)
#   64  record armed
#   128 record monitoring on
#   256 record monitoring auto
#   512 UNDOCUMENTED - observed set on master and on tracks with FX + monitoring;
#       main.js does not define this bit. Parser must ignore unknown bits rather
#       than assume the documented set is exhaustive.
#
# color is 0xAARRGGBB, decimal in the wire format.

TRACK	1	MIDI Signal	708	1.000000	0.000000	-1500	-1500	1.000000	5	0	0	0	28677999

TRACK	3	VIDEO	0	1.000000	0.000000	-1500	-1500	1.000000	5	0	0	0	21382726
